title: senecio johnstonii subsp. elgonensis
intro: Senecio johnstonii subsp. elgonensis, commonly known as Elgon senecio, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the daisy family, native to the Mount Elgon region in East Africa. It has been traditionally used in medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin infections, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Elgon senecio include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating these conditions. The bioactive constituents of Elgon senecio include sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, and other compounds such as flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its antioxidant and antimicrobial activities.
